# old-invocation-allowlist.txt — files that may still name the old build invocation (spec 0250
# R31, delta-01). scripts/tests/build-components-references.test.ts fails on any other tracked
# or untracked text file that names it as an instruction.
#
# Format: one repo-relative path per line; an entry ending in `/` covers every file below that
# directory. Every entry carries a reason as the `#` comment line directly above it. An entry
# that no longer matches a file with a hit, or that appears twice, fails the suite.

# The shim itself: its header and usage text name the invocation it keeps working.
scripts/build-components.sh

# Spec 0250 R23: the unmigrated shell scripts that still reach the entry through the shim.
scripts/lib/common.sh
scripts/lib/component-resolve.sh

# The shim header names these as the callers that stay on the shim until their own row:
# the setup scripts, whose hints tell the user to run the build first.
scripts/setup-claude-interactive.sh
scripts/setup-copilot-interactive.sh
scripts/setup-gemini-interactive.sh

# The shim header names the Bash tests that have not migrated: each deliberately drives the shim.
scripts/tests/test-model-resolution.sh
scripts/tests/test-pr-logbook-label-scope.sh
tests/e2e/scenarios/03-skill-build/run.sh

# Spec text and delta-specs record the invocation as it was specified; merged specs are history.
specs/

# docs/adoption-guide.md line 226 documents that the old invocation still works and forwards.
docs/adoption-guide.md

# docs/authoring.md line 82 re-derives emissions printed by the old invocation at a pinned commit.
docs/authoring.md

# docs/agent-profile-migration.md line 189 names the old invocation as the measured baseline.
docs/agent-profile-migration.md

# docs/cli-matrix.md names the old invocation in the shim description and in rows whose cited
# behaviour is the unmigrated shell scripts' auto-build, which still goes through the shim.
docs/cli-matrix.md

# Scenario 03 deliberately drives the shim end to end inside the e2e container; its run.sh is
# allowlisted for the same reason and its prompt is the instruction the agent receives.
tests/e2e/scenarios/03-skill-build/sample-skill.prompt

# Spec 0255 R5/R6 (row F2): the TypeScript twins of the shell resolution and manage scripts
# reproduce, byte for byte, the hints and the report the shell prints ("run bash
# scripts/build-components.sh first"); the shim stays until row J4, so the hint stays true.
scripts/lib/component-overlay.ts
scripts/lib/component-roots.ts
scripts/lib/manage/confirm.ts
scripts/lib/manage/descriptors.ts

# Spec 0255 R5: the unit test that pins the byte-for-byte hint of component-roots.ts.
scripts/tests/component-roots.test.ts

# A recorded Copilot CLI integration-test log: it documents the commands as they were run and
# is history, not an instruction.
tests/copilot-cli-integration.md

# Spec 0255 PR E: the manage scripts became shims of scripts/manage-*-component.ts; the golden
# facts below keep the link-mode warning text the shell printed ("run bash
# scripts/build-components.sh first"), which the TypeScript descriptors reproduce byte for byte.
scripts/tests/fixtures/manage-shell-facts/antigravity.facts.golden
scripts/tests/fixtures/manage-shell-facts/claude.facts.golden
scripts/tests/fixtures/manage-shell-facts/copilot.facts.golden
scripts/tests/fixtures/manage-shell-facts/workspace.facts.golden
